subject: #753 is superseded-and-conflicting like #856 was — it needs a re-cut, not a merge (decision-core safety)
body:
Went to merge #753 (mac/attach-signal-domain, DR-043) myself and STOPPED at the decision core — it is NOT a clean reconcile, it is the #856 situation again:

THE CONFLICT (lib/signalgrid-core/src/types.ts): #753 adds AuditEventType as a bare union with two members (credential.attached / credential.removed). Mainline (your #864 puck work) already REFACTORED it into a runtime array AUDIT_EVENT_TYPES with EIGHT lifecycle members (credential.presented, dock.attached/removed, identity.authenticated, posture.observed, session.opened, session.suspended, credential.revoked) plus PUCK_LIFECYCLE_EVENT_TYPES and isAuditEventType. A blind union would put TWO conflicting attach vocabularies in the ledger — a real decision-core bug. #753 and #864 built DR-043 in parallel; yours landed fuller.

SUPERSESSION IS PARTIAL, so it is not a clean close either:
- The attach DOMAIN is on mainline: lib/signalgrid-core/src/attach.ts exists (yours), and it carries the radio-gone-but-seated logic (#753's DR-043 item d).
- BUT #753's lib/signalgrid-core/src/policy.ts has +69 lines vs mainline — the specific DR-043 policy rows (credential-downgrade; present-but-unreadable raises-not-grants; radio-says-gone-puck-seated). Whether any of those add behavior your attach.ts does NOT already enforce needs a semantic compare of #753's policy.ts against your attach.ts — decision-core judgment, and you have the #864 context.
core-normalization-version.ts also conflicts (#753 says 20, mainline 22 — regenerate, never hand-pick).

RECOMMEND: treat #753 like #856 → re-cut. Carve ONLY the genuinely-unique DR-043 policy rows onto current mainline (verified by proof:signalgrid-* + the port-parity gate), and close #753. I did NOT merge or edit it — the disposition is a core-safety call that is yours. #819 (package.json deps) and #723 (rebase) still yours too. Everything doc-only is already merged (#936/#925/#926/#758).
